findings.summary: Replay and duplicate denial are represented by aggregate counts/table labels rather than exact per-scenario receipt surfaces.

Negative matrix mostly verifies declared labels instead of exercising stale, duplicate, reordered, unsigned, wrong-domain, cross-Polis, authority-mutation, and credential-binding inputs as fail-closed behavior.
Retained evidence packet omits the exact scenario denominator, ACIP vector denominator, receipt schema, contract digest, fixture digest, and validation output promised by the design.
The qualification module is not exported from the adl_runtime crate and the test bypasses the public crate boundary with a path include.

residual_risks: Review was read-only and did not run live cloud/provider proof; #506 does not claim live cloud/provider execution.
